evidence.quote: The language of instruction in this program is English.
The degree programme is taught in English.
The tuition fees for international students from third countries for this degree program are 2,000 euros per semester.

notes: Deadline year not stated on the page; 2027 chosen as the next occurrence. Application is via TUMonline (not uni-assist as far as the pages state), so applicationChannel omitted. OMITTED: intakes (no page states the year of the deadline, only day and month; verifier requires the year; expected next deadline is 15 July 2027 per DAAD 2026/2027 edition). TUM REQUIREMENTS: official pages used: TUM programme page, TUM 'International Higher Education Entrance Qualification' page, DAAD 11020. The TUM pages do not say whether the Moroccan Bac is comparable to the Abitur; uni-assist (VPD) decides whether the certificate gives direct access or Studienkolleg is needed. English: TUM says no proof of language proficiency is needed but a good command of English is expected; DAAD says 'B2 required/recommended, no proof required' (ambiguous required/recommended), so minCefr B2 with certificateRequired=false.

note.fr: Un bon niveau d'anglais est attendu (le DAAD indique B2 comme exigé ou recommandé) ; aucune preuve n'est demandée : vérifiez votre niveau.
note.en: A good command of English is expected (the DAAD lists B2 as required or recommended); no proof is requested: check your level.
note.ar: يُتوقع مستوى جيد في اللغة الإنجليزية (يذكر DAAD المستوى B2 كشرط أو توصية)؛ ولا يُطلب إثبات: تحقّقوا من مستواكم.

evidence.quote: You do not need to provide proof of language proficiency for this degree program. However, applicants should have a good command of English.
English language skills B2 required/recommended, no proof required

note.fr: Si le diplôme de fin d'études étranger n'est pas comparable à l'Abitur, l'admission directe n'est possible qu'après le Studienkolleg et l'examen d'évaluation (Feststellungsprüfung).
note.en: If your foreign school-leaving certificate is not comparable to the Abitur, direct admission is only possible after the Studienkolleg and the assessment exam (Feststellungsprüfung).
note.ar: إذا كانت شهادتكم الأجنبية غير قابلة للمقارنة بالـ Abitur، فلا يمكن القبول المباشر إلا بعد Studienkolleg واجتياز امتحان التقييم (Feststellungsprüfung).

evidence.quote: If a school-leaving degree from another country is not comparable to the German university entrance qualification, direct admission can only be granted after attending a Studienkollegs (preparatory studies) and after having taken the university qualification assessment examination.

note.fr: Demander avant la candidature l'attestation préliminaire (VPD) à uni-assist, qui vérifie si le diplôme donne accès général ou limité à certaines matières.
note.en: Before applying, request the preliminary review certificate (VPD) from uni-assist, which checks whether your diploma gives general or subject-restricted access.
note.ar: اطلبوا قبل التقدّم شهادة المراجعة الأولية (VPD) من uni-assist، التي تتحقق هل تتيح شهادتكم ولوجًا عامًا أم مقيّدًا ببعض المواد.

evidence.quote: All applicants who have not obtained their higher education entrance qualification in Germany or have not completed their German school-leaving examination (Abitur), must apply for a Preliminary Documentation (VPD) to uni-assist before submitting an application to TUM.

note.fr: Participation obligatoire au test d'aptitude en ligne (Aptitude Recommendation, environ 20 minutes) ; le résultat n'influence pas l'admission.
note.en: Mandatory online aptitude test (Aptitude Recommendation, about 20 minutes); the result does not affect admission.
note.ar: اختبار الكفاءة عبر الإنترنت إلزامي (Aptitude Recommendation، حوالي 20 دقيقة)؛ ولا تؤثر نتيجته على القبول.

evidence.quote: However, participation in the test – and the corresponding proof – is mandatory for the application.
